gen-tourney-gf-athiti: Tourney stretches its wide-tracked, bulky little letters in a single stroke width, loud and athletic, with real swagger. Athiti lets light through its s and sits its mean line high.
gen-tourney-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-nex: Tourney bends wire-like strokes of constant thickness into wide-tracked, bulky letters with a bold, athletic swagger. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next has big, unlatched lowercase eyes, the pair's real hook.
gen-tourney-gf-blinker: Readable lowercase that fills most of the line gives Tourney, with its wide-tracked bulk, a friendly counterpart. Blinker holds its line thickness steady, and that sturdy openness is the pair's best trait.
gen-tourney-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills the line with big lowercase and a widely parted s, drawn from one stroke width. But Tourney, stretched wide and athletic, gives this pair its punch.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-guntur: Tourney spreads out wide, bulky and uniform in stroke. Hind Guntur then moves through paragraphs with wide gaps at the curve ends and tall, stamped-metal lowercase, steady as a cable.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at a constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. While Tourney swaggers in wide, bulky, athletic letters, the text beside it stays gentle and approachable.
gen-tourney-gf-huninn: Loud up top, sturdy below, all in stout lines. Tourney is best at shouting in wide-tracked, bulky letters, while Huninn does its job with lowercase rising near cap height and fat crossbars.
gen-tourney-gf-inter-tight: Tourney stamps out wide-tracked, bulky letters in a single stroke width, bold and athletic from the first glance. Inter Tight flows through paragraphs like bent tubing, short ascenders and tucked tails.
gen-tourney-gf-michroma: Trace it with a finger: bold, wide, athletic. Tourney keeps its bulky letters at constant width, while Michroma gives every lowercase letter a wide berth, leaving daylight in the curves for a spacious read.
gen-tourney-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline has lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Tourney brings wide-tracked, bulky, athletic swagger above it, so giving the text a touch more size lets those open counters breathe.
